title: Dive 10: Bucket List Brine
place: Gulf of Mexico seafloor (ROV dive, Okeanos Explorer EX1711)
notes: SPARE. ROV view of the 'shoreline' of a brine pool (an underwater lake on the seafloor) with mussel shells. The shot is fairly static and darker and less dramatic than the others. The cut leaves out the NOAA logo card (0-4 s) and the end cards. Audio is continuous with no gaps and is probably a music bed, so mute it. Source is 1280x720. No people.
fact_en: This brine pool is essentially an underwater lake; the salinity of the water in such pools can be three to eight times more than the surrounding water, so the denser brine sinks and forms a pool.
